narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>I say parallel lines have the same length, so I draw them equal.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But parallel lines can have any lengths. One can be short, and the other long.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>What matters is the same steps, and not the same length.
